proposed_comments.title: Do not let unsupported URI or non-image file candidates suppress later fallbacks

confidence.rationale: The availability switch accepts every non-file URI and every existing local file without checking whether the scheme or extension is supported, so the ordered search can stop on a value that cannot render.

proposed_comments.body:
### Do not let unsupported URI or non-image file candidates suppress later fallbacks

**Severity:** `high`

This branch treats every non-file URI and every existing local file as an available icon. An unsupported URI such as `steam://...`, or an existing non-image file, can therefore stop the ordered search even though it cannot produce an icon, so a later valid fallback is never tried. Please restrict accepted URI schemes and local file types to formats the icon materializer supports, and continue to the next candidate when this check fails.

proposed_comments.title: Keep the generic app icon visible while a deferred row icon loads

confidence.rationale: The constructor now assigns the unresolved protocol request directly; the deferred source is applied only after asynchronous loading, which can leave cold or recycled rows without a stable placeholder.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the generic app icon visible while a deferred row icon loads

**Severity:** `medium`

Assigning the unresolved protocol request directly removes the stable placeholder that Installed Apps rows previously had while extraction was in progress. On a cold load or a recycled list item, the row can remain blank or retain stale presentation until the asynchronous request completes. Please publish `GenericAppIcon` immediately and replace it with the deferred request only when that icon load is ready.

proposed_comments.title: Add the generic app glyph as the terminal row-icon candidate

confidence.rationale: The row request contains only the selected icon path and executable path, so exhausting both candidates can replace the temporary placeholder with an empty result.

proposed_comments.body:
### Add the generic app glyph as the terminal row-icon candidate

**Severity:** `medium`

The deferred row request currently ends after `iconPath` and `ExePath`. If neither candidate can produce an icon, the completed request can still replace the row's temporary placeholder with an empty source. Please append the existing generic app glyph as the final ordered candidate so failed extraction settles on a stable icon instead of a blank row.

proposed_comments.title: Give every jumbo app-icon request a terminal generic fallback

confidence.rationale: All three unpackaged hero request shapes can exhaust their path candidates, and none currently includes the existing generic app glyph as the final candidate.

proposed_comments.body:
### Give every jumbo app-icon request a terminal generic fallback

**Severity:** `medium`

The unpackaged hero requests can exhaust `JumboIconPath`, `IcoPath`, and `ExePath` without producing a usable source. In that case the details view can still end up with no stable app image. Please append `GenericAppIcon` as the final candidate for this request and the other two `CreateJumbo` branches below so every hero path has the same terminal fallback policy.

proposed_comments.title: Carry the outer font family into per-candidate protocol preparation

confidence.rationale: Resolving each candidate inside the protocol processor is required by the already-open candidate-order concern, but this asynchronous processor contract currently receives no font-family value, so glyph fallback would regress to the default font.

proposed_comments.body:
### Carry the outer font family into per-candidate protocol preparation

**Severity:** `medium`

Addressing the existing ordered-candidate concern requires the app protocol processor to complete ordinary conversion for each candidate before advancing. This call does not pass the outer `fontFamily`, so moving that conversion into the processor would make a glyph fallback silently render with the default font instead of the font declared by `IconData`. Please extend the processor contract to carry the font family through this path and use it when a glyph candidate wins.
